gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Unica One draws every stroke at a single thickness, with a very large lowercase eye and daylight inside each curve. Noto Sans Tai Tham, a plain sans, packs chalkboard-style lowercase up toward the capital line.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Unica One is a commanding display face whose outlines are consistently thick, with no thin strokes anywhere. Noto Sans Tai Viet answers with short ascenders and a tall x-height, a sans whose curve terminals pull back politely.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-takri: Unica One keeps every joint clean, so strokes meet without thinning or bulging, and the lowercase eye is huge. Noto Sans Takri, a plain sans, leaves its small round letters generously unclosed.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Not one thick or thin stroke appears in any Unica One letter, only a single steady line with a huge lowercase eye. Noto Sans Tamil, the sans-serif below, looks magnified, its terminals stopping well short of the stem.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supp: Unica One pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle, one thickness throughout, with daylight inside every curve. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement, the sans-serif here, favors round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Rope-fine linework, commanding and unmistakable, makes up every Unica One letter, with a very large lowercase eye. Noto Sans Tangsa, a plain sans, sits below with wide, inviting round letters and short ascender stems.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tc: A lowercase a with no thin hairlines gives Unica One its look. Noto Sans TC, a sans, does the quieter job, with large open counters in a, e and s and curves that open outward.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-telugu: One unbroken line weight runs through Unica One from terminals to junctions, with a very large lowercase eye. And Noto Sans Telugu, a sans with a high-set midline, keeps its counters connected to the outside.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-thai: Single-weight and commanding, Unica One leaves daylight inside every curve under its very large lowercase eye. Then Noto Sans Thai, a sans, swells its lowercase like inflated glass beads and leaves rounded letters open.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-thai-loope: A lowercase n whose arch and stem match in weight is the clearest sign of Unica One, whose strokes never vary. Noto Sans Thai Looped feels bold beside it, its tall bodies and spacious curve terminals giving a clean sans texture.
